question: Did we learn transferable STRATEGIES, or memorise two specific opponents?

treated_as_a_second_preregistered_benchm.rationale: if the held-out variants are tuned after seeing learned-policy results, 'unseen' erodes immediately. They are frozen with the same discipline as the V3 poles.
treated_as_a_second_preregistered_benchm.generate: A1..A3 and B1..B3 as frozen SDS genome overlays on the canonical bases
treated_as_a_second_preregistered_benchm.validate_with: the SCRIPTED GUARD/BREACH reference policies ONLY, on a separate development block
treated_as_a_second_preregistered_benchm.validation_criterion: each variant must preserve its intended strategic family: A-like variants demand GUARD (WR(GUARD) > WR(BREACH)), B-like variants demand BREACH
treated_as_a_second_preregistered_benchm.then: FREEZE. The learned policies must NEVER be used to tune, select, or filter the variants.
treated_as_a_second_preregistered_benchm.prohibited: regenerating a variant because a learned policy performed unexpectedly on it

mutation_axes.constraint: physically meaningful characteristics only, drawn from the SAME legal gene ranges already frozen in experiments/sds_genome.py. The strategic FAMILY must remain intact; these are not new strategies.
mutation_axes.ranges_declared_prospectively: the allowable range per axis is fixed in this record before any variant is generated

seed_blocks.variant_development: a fresh audited block, used ONLY for scripted-reference family validation
seed_blocks.held_out_evaluation: a separate fresh audited block, untouched until the comparison runs
seed_blocks.rule: audit both with scripts/audit_seed_block.py over the FULL range including git history, before use

comparison_table.claim_under_test: the latent modes capture transferable strategic responses rather than opponent-specific behaviours
comparison_table.worst_case_matters: a method that wins on average but collapses on one variant has not generalised

prohibited: selecting which variants to report after seeing results
reusing the variant-development block for the held-out comparison
running any part of this before Experiments 1 and 2 pass
